decisions.decision: The committee decided to highlight the residential development 'cost avoidance' attribute while discussing the conceptual development plan and again at the end of the presentation, because it lacked specific numbers on state reimbursement.
decisions.quote: it was decided to highlight the residential development "cost avoidance" attribute of the project while discussing the conceptual development plan, and again at the end of the presentation.

decisions.decision: The draft presentation for the Finance Committee was approved for delivery (with the residential cost discussion added).
decisions.quote: the presentation was otherwise approved for delivery to the finance committee.

decisions.decision: The Town selected Ken Croft of The Foster Company as the appraiser, citing local familiarity and a lower bid.
decisions.quote: because his bid was lower than the other firm, the town selected mr. croft.

budget_items.topic: Residential development impact on Town and school budgets
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula Bertram suggested adding information on the budget impact of residential development, particularly the cost per student on the school budget; no figures were printed.
budget_items.quote: paula bertram suggested adding information about the impact to the town budget development

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The three appraisal bids were all within a couple of hundred dollars of each other; the lower bid of the selected firm was a factor in choosing Ken Croft.
budget_items.quote: were all within a couple hundred dollars of each other

budget_items.topic: Water line cut and cap cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The seller had not yet agreed to cut and cap the water line and wanted to discuss the prospective cost before agreement; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: last outstanding item is whether or not the seller will agree to cut and cap the water line
